jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Fixed Term) - (Logistics, Workforce) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Senior Data Scientist (Fixed Term)

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Fixed Term) to join our Logistics team to help us create a fast, reliable and transparent delivery experience. You will make an impact in optimizing our on-demand last-mile delivery operations, involving hundreds of thousands of couriers and restaurants, improving the experience for millions orders per day in 65+ countries.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Your mission:

- Conceptualize the right modeling approach for challenges in the field of Logistics at scale, together with your squad lead and our stakeholders.
- Innovate new modeling solutions by drawing from fields like Machine Learning, Operations Research and Statistics that drive value for our business.
- Pair-program with your squad to engineer solutions that automate the retraining of models and generation of predictions.
- Provide ideas in brainstorming sessions with your Data Science colleagues to solve the toughest modeling problems together.
- Help defining data needs to bring value to the projects, collaborate with the data engineering and tech teams in planning their roadmap.
- Work with (semi-)structured data from our BigQuery DWH architecture and process with Spark where necessary.

Qualifications

- You have at least 5 years of experience applying methods from machine learning to real-world datasets.
- Fluency in Python and familiarity with its scientific/visualization libraries such as NumPy numpy, Ppandas, Sscikit-learn, Mmatplotlib, Pplotly etc.
- You can transfer business problems from a problem space to a technical solution space.
- Experience in solving regression and classification-typeclassification type of problems with statistical, linear/non-linear models and ensemble models in particular (Random Forest/XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost).
- Experience with Time-Series Forecasting, Operations Research, and Statistics is an interesting addition
- You know how to work with Big Data platforms such as Big Query/Spark and know how to write a SQL query to pull the data you need.
- You can write maintainable code that follows best practices in software engineering.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer II (Golang) to join our AdTech tribe. You'll help build our next-generation advertising platform that helps partners – restaurants and local shops – promote their best dishes, attract new customers, and grow their business. If you enjoy solving concrete engineering problems, growing your ownership over real production systems, and learning from a senior, distributed team, this is a great next step – and Berlin is waiting for you.

You'll join the squad owning a critical piece of the AdTech ecosystem: the Campaigns Squad, which powers the creation and management of campaigns across all Delivery Hero brands globally, and the Advertiser Service, the central solution for advertiser data. You will contribute to the scalability, performance, and resilience of these services as part of a squad supporting a global user base.

- Own and deliver well-scoped features end-to-end within the Campaigns and Advertiser services, from design input through to production.
- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Go code that meets the team's engineering and security standards.
- Contribute to architecture and design discussions for the features you build, with guidance from senior engineers.
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other squads across the AdTech tribe to ship reliable solutions.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the services you help maintain, escalating and learning as needed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, estimations, and team ceremonies, and keep growing your technical and business understanding.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
- Hands-on experience with Go (or strong proficiency in another backend language plus a genuine interest in Go) and a good understanding of service-oriented / microservices patterns.
- Experience with relational (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
- Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes, and a willingness to deepen this knowledge.
- A quality-first mindset: you write tests, care about readability, and are comfortable asking for and giving feedback in code reviews.
- Good communication skills and fluent English.

Tesla's retail stores are more than sales floors, they are the physical expression of our brand, our products, and our mission. As Regional Retail Program Specialist you will support the connection between EMEA retail marketing strategy and real customer experience on the ground. As part of the Central Europe Sales Operations team, you will work alongside the Customer Engagement, CX, Infradev, and local store teams to help ensure that every program, every asset, and every touchpoint tells a consistent, curated story from the moment a customer walks in the door.This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that requires presence in market. You will travel regularly within Central Europe to support program rollouts, conduct brand standard checks, and build the kind of trusted local relationships that help EMEA strategy land.

What You’ll Do

- Support the consistent implementation of brand standards across all locations in Central Europe
- Support the implementation of retail programs in market, including new product launches, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen initiatives
- Coordinate retail refresh initiatives and brand asset distribution across locations in Central Europe
- Conduct regular store standard checks across each location and report field observations, learnings, and local market dynamics to the relevant teams
- Support and inform different stakeholders on new and existing store developments, helping ensure retail standards and educational elements are integrated
- Support the piloting of new retail concepts and sales tools locally, and help facilitate best practice sharing across markets
- Build and maintain comprehensive database of brand assets and equipment for each location in Central Europe

What You’ll Bring

- 1–2 years of experience in retail marketing, operations, or a related field - ideally within a consumer brand, automotive, or tech environment
- Good understanding of in-store brand experience, consumer journey, and retail standards
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, with support from senior team members
- Highly collaborative - comfortable working across functions including marketing, operations, design, and facilities
- Organised and detail-oriented, with a hands-on approach to execution and follow-through
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly within Central Europe — this role requires a consistent in-market presence

Außendienstmitarbeiter Vertrieb (m/w/d) - Für Technisches Schuhwerk / Schwerpunkt Feuerwehr

Als Hersteller von hoch technischem Sicherheitsschuhwerk für die Bereiche Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienst, Polizei und Militär ist die Stumpp & Baier GmbH international präsent. Wir sind ein mittelständiges Familienunternehmen am Standort Heidenau bei Dresden.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir eine engagierte Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die eigenständig handelt, Chancen erkennt und unser Feuerwehrgeschäft erfolgreich weiterentwickelt.

Das Vertriebsgebiet umfasst zunächst die Südhälfte Deutschlands sowie Österreich und die Schweiz – alternativ Ostdeutschland und Österreich. Im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums setzen wir die Bereitschaft voraus, perspektivisch auch größere oder zusätzliche Gebiete zu übernehmen.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Feuerwehrgeschäft systematisch weiter und werden an klar definierten, ambitionierten und realistischen Vertriebszielen gemessen. Dazu gehört:

- Aktive Neukundengewinnung und Ausbau unseres Feuerwehrgeschäfts
- Betreuung von Berufsfeuerwehren, Handelspartnern und weiteren relevanten Endkunden
- Eigenständige Entwicklung und Bearbeitung Ihres Vertriebsgebiets
- Erkennen und konsequentes Nutzen von Umsatzpotenzialen
- Unterstützung und vertriebliche Begleitung der Außendienstteams unserer Handelspartner
- Kundenbesuche und Entwicklung passender Vertriebsmaßnahmen
- Beobachtung von Markt und Wettbewerb
- Aufbau langfristiger und erfolgreicher Kundenbeziehungen

Ihr Profil

- Mindestens drei Jahre nachweislich erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Vertriebsaußendienst
- Hohe Eigeninitiative, Abschlussstärke und klare Ergebnisorientierung
- Gute Kenntnisse der deutschen Feuerwehrstruktur sind von Vorteil, idealerweise aus vertrieblicher Sicht; alternativ oder ergänzend ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Verbrauchs- oder Gebrauchsgütern wünschenswert
- Freude daran, Kunden und Vertriebspartner für anspruchsvolle und funktionale Produkte zu begeistern
- Hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft, Flexibilität und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Unser Angebot

- Attraktives Gehalt mit erfolgsabhängigem variablem Anteil
- Dienstwagen
- Firmenhandy und Laptop
- Eigenverantwortliches Vertriebsgebiet mit großem Entwicklungspotenzial
- Perspektive zur Übernahme größerer Vertriebsverantwortung
- Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen
- Ein engagiertes Team und eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Geschäftsbereich

Wir freuen uns auf eine Persönlichkeit, die gerne etwas bewegt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

jobs.title: Jefe de Mantenimiento (Leiter/in - Betriebliche Instandhaltung)
jobs.description:
Jefe de Mantenimiento

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 95 hoteles en 13 países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

Como Jefe de Mantenimiento, será responsable de supervisar y coordinar el mantenimiento integral del establecimiento, garantizando el correcto funcionamiento de las instalaciones, equipos y sistemas. Asimismo, trabajará en coordinación con proveedores y empresas de servicios externas para asegurar unos estándares óptimos de calidad, seguridad y eficiencia.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se encuentran:

- Supervisar el correcto funcionamiento de los equipos, ascensores e instalaciones técnicas de todo el establecimiento, realizando un seguimiento exhaustivo de cualquier incidencia o deficiencia detectada.
- Actuar como principal enlace de comunicación y coordinación con empresas y proveedores externos, especialmente en la planificación, supervisión y seguimiento de los trabajos de mantenimiento.
- Realizar inspecciones diarias de las instalaciones con el objetivo de identificar posibles averías, desperfectos o necesidades de mantenimiento, así como ejecutar o coordinar las correspondientes labores de reparación y renovación.
- Colaborar estrechamente con los distintos departamentos del establecimiento, adquiriendo una visión transversal de las operaciones y ampliando conocimientos en nuevas áreas de actividad dentro de un entorno de trabajo multicultural.

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

- Formación técnica y/o experiencia profesional previa en puestos relacionados con el mantenimiento de edificios, instalaciones o equipos técnicos. También se valorarán perfiles con experiencia en otros ámbitos técnicos que deseen desarrollar su carrera profesional en el sector hotelero.
- Certificación oficial en materia de prevención y control de Legionella, de acuerdo con la normativa vigente en España, para el mantenimiento higiénico-sanitario de instalaciones de riesgo por Legionella.
- Persona responsable, organizada, proactiva y resolutiva, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma.
- Interés por la tecnología y atención al detalle, con orientación a la prevención y detección de posibles incidencias.
- Flexibilidad, capacidad de adaptación y creatividad para encontrar soluciones eficaces, manteniendo siempre un alto estándar de calidad, incluso en situaciones de presión.
- Clara orientación al trabajo en equipo y disposición para colaborar con los diferentes departamentos del hotel, entendiendo que los objetivos son comunes y que la colaboración entre equipos es fundamental para garantizar el buen funcionamiento del establecimiento.

Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.

Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome) einfach per E-Mail an uns. Wir begleiten Sie diskret, kostenfrei und Schritt für Schritt auf Ihrem Weg zu Ihrer neuen Herausforderung in der Schweiz!

jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) in Mamer

OG Recruitment is your consulting agency for the recruitment of specialists in Luxembourg and the entire border region. We are exclusively concerned with direct placements with our clients. No temporary employment.

On behalf of our renowned client with headquarters in Mamer (L) we are looking for an Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) for mechanical and electrical satellite systems.

The position will be filled directly and permanent with the client.

Our client is an innovative, Luxembourg based high-tech company with several state-of-the-art divisions.

Your tasks

- Design electrical installations and controller solutions for the satellite ground segment and the rubber industry testing equipment:
- Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products,
- Create electrical concepts and drawings,
- Identify, assess and mitigate safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and define electrical safety concepts to address those,
- Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components.
- Interact with internal & external customers and suppliers in order to promote, improve and troubleshoot the customers electrical and automated solutions:
- Present, explain and defend important features and concepts in discussions with the customers and use their feedback to improve and troubleshoot the products,
- Interact with suppliers to select components and perform obsolescence management.

Your profile

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or automation engineering
- 3 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field of activity, including good understanding of electrical and electro-mechanical installations and power electronics
- Design of electrical installations, including electro-mechanical devices such as motors, and related drawings (EPLAN P8)
- Ability to perform safety analyses of electro-mechanical machinery (using tools such as Safexpert, Sistema) and to design electrical systems fulfilling the common safety norms (such as the machinery directive 2006/42/EC)
- PLC software development is considered a plus (e.g. PLCopen Structured Text ST)
- Good team spirit
- Ability to adapt to new situations and work with various type of stakeholders and partners to achieve the desired results
- Ability to work in an English-speaking environment including technical discussions and documentation activities, German, French and Luxembourgish being considered as a plus

What we offer

- A permanent employment contract directly with the client
- Attractive salary
- Great working atmosphere and modern, multi national working environment
- Dynamic environment
- Attractive career development opportunities

How it proceeds

- You are welcome to apply online and click on the "Apply" button
- If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us by phone or e-mail.
- We will review your documents and arrange a telephone call or personal meeting to get to know you.

Discretion comes first

- We guarantee the utmost confidentiality of your application.
- We work responsibly in accordance with the GDPR.

Sounds good? Then apply now. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Massage- & Physiotherapie im Alegria Health & Recovery Center "Playitas Sportresort- Fuerteventura" (Physiotherapeut/in (Sportphysiotherapie))
jobs.description:
Arbeite dort, wo andere trainieren und Urlaub machen – im besten Sportresort Europas!
Für unser Alegria Health & Recovery Center im Playitas Sportresort auf Fuerteventura suchen wir dynamische, sportbegeisterte Teamplayer in den Bereichen Massage und Physiotherapie.

Seit über 30 Jahren sind wir auf den Kanaren in den Bereichen Sportmedizin, Wellness, Health und Kosmetik tätig – und jetzt möchten wir unser Team erweitern. Werde Teil eines einzigartigen Umfelds, in dem Freizeit- und Spitzensportler täglich an ihre Grenzen gehen und sich bei uns regenerieren.

Deine Aufgaben

- Durchführung unserer angebotenen Behandlungen (Sportmassage, Wellness, Physio)
- Fachkundige Beratung unserer Sportler und Gäste
- Planung, Organisation und Abrechnung deiner Behandlungen
- Eigenverantwortliches, qualitäts- und serviceorientiertes Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit

- Eine fundierte, anerkannte Ausbildung im Bereich Massage oder Physiotherapie
- Fähigkeit, individuell auf Freizeit- bis Spitzensportler einzugehen
- Ausgeprägte Service- und Qualitätsorientierung
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (Voraussetzung)
- Sportliche, positive Ausstrahlung und Teamgeist

Das bieten wir dir

- Abwechslungsreiches, verantwortungsvolles Arbeiten im internationalen Leistungssport-Umfeld
- Unterkunft im Personalbereich des Resort
- Verpflegung
- Nutzung der Trainingsmöglichkeiten im Playitas Sportresort
- Arbeiten in einer der schönsten Regionen Europas – Sonne, Meer und Sport das ganze Jahr

Werde Teil unseres Teams!

Wenn du Lust hast, in einem sportlichen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und Athleten auf ihrem Weg zu Bestleistungen zu begleiten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
jobs.description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 80 hotels in 12 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

Looking after our guests in a professional manner at the front desk is extremely important at all times – from a warm welcome at check-in until their departure, your job will be to assist our early risers and night owls. Your duties will also include the following:

- Welcoming guests, checking in and out.
- Preparing daily closing balances
- Cash transactions and cashing up
- Processing booking requests
- Preparing and serving Drinks.
- Preparing for breakfast
- General light cleaning of the lobby and public areas.

Qualifications

Whether you are a hotel professional or changing careers – you will fit in here! Because personality and hosting skills are our priority. You will also:

- Have an excellent sense of quality and service, as well as hosting skills and a passion for the hotel industry
- Be open, communicative and confident and have a solid command of English
- Be a team player and willing to provide assistance across departments – we achieve our results together
- Applicants must be able to speak, read, and understand English to effectively communicate in the role.

Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description:
Recepcionista

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

El objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out
- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones
- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo
- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)
- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturales

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

jobs.title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

jobs.title: Nurse (Poland) (Krankenschwester/-pfleger)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.

jobs.title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
jobs.description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

Description

When you order items on Amazon, there are practically thousands of ways we can fulfill that order. Which Fulfillment Center do we ship from, what carriers do we use, what boxes do we combine items in — now scale that question to billions of items shipped annually worldwide. At Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT), we are tasked with fulfilling every customer order in the most intelligent way possible while making sure customers get their orders on time.

Within SCOT, the Fulfillment Optimization organization owns the artificial intelligence, optimization, and simulation systems that decide how Amazon's outbound network is planned and operated. You will take well-defined requirements, build a solution, and deliver it on schedule. You will learn the team's data architecture deeply, contribute to its evolution, and grow into an autonomous owner of significant pieces of it.

This role is a great fit for someone who is excited about working with large-scale, complex data, who cares about getting the details right, and who wants to grow under the mentorship of an experienced data engineering team.

Key job responsibilities

Build and optimize physical data models and ETL pipelines for datasets that serve our products and analytics, using Amazon's data platforms (Redshift, EMR, Spark, S3, Hive, etc.)
- Take well-defined requirements from Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Software Development Engineers, and deliver tested, documented, and maintainable data solutions on schedule
- Troubleshoot, root-cause, and resolve issues in existing datasets and pipelines, leaving them better and easier to maintain than you found them
- Measure and improve dataset quality — completeness, freshness, correctness — and contribute to the team's monitoring and SLA framework
- Write secure, stable, testable, and well-documented code in SQL and Python (or Scala), and submit it for code review
- Classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon's security and privacy policies

- Collaborate with peers across Fulfillment Optimization and partner teams to integrate data sources and unblock downstream consumers

A day in the life

You will spend your day writing SQL and Python, designing tables and pipelines, reviewing teammates' code, and pairing with data scientists and engineers to understand what they need from the data. You will start with well-scoped pieces of work — a new dataset, an optimization to an existing pipeline, an investigation into a data quality issue — and grow your scope as you build context. You will be supported by a team that values mentorship, code review, and writing things down.

About the team

The Fulfillment Optimization organization owns and operates the artificial intelligence, optimization, and simulation systems that plan and run Amazon's outbound fulfillment network. The organization is spread across the United States and Europe and is multi-disciplinary — Research Science, Applied Science, Business Intelligence, Product Management, Data Engineering, and Software Development. Our team is a newly formed horizontal team responsible for the data foundations that all Fulfillment Optimization products and analytics depend on. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

jobs.description:
Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator
Levi, Lapland, Scandinavian Travel Group

We are looking for a reliable, energetic and hands-on Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator to join our team in Levi for the winter season 2026–2027.
This role supports the smooth daily flow of our winter operations. You will keep guest clothing and equipment clean, dry and ready for departures, assist guests with outfitting, and help maintain a clean and organized office environment.

WORK LOCATION & CONDITIONS
- Location: Scandinavian Travel Group office, Keskuskuja 2 B, Levi
- Working mode: Full-time, on-site
- Main office language: English
- Contract period: fixed-term employment 01.11.2026–31.03.2027
- Application deadline: 31.07.2026

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Winter clothing and gear management
-Cleaning, drying, disinfecting, sorting and organizing winter clothing and equipment
-Preparing correct sizes and clothing sets for guest departures
-Checking the condition of overalls, boots, helmets and other equipment
-Handling basic replacements, repairs and maintenance needs
-Keeping simple washing and maintenance records
2.Guest outfitting
-Helping guests dress and undress before and after activities
-Selecting correct sizes for overalls, boots, helmets and other gear
-Advising guests on layering and staying warm in Arctic conditions
-Providing friendly, efficient and practical customer service during busy departure times
3.Office housekeeping
-Keeping the kitchen, staff areas, front desk zone and entrance clean, safe and organized
-Supporting daily cleanliness in customer-facing and staff areas
-Maintaining a tidy and professional working environment throughout the day

REQUIREMENTS
-Good English skills are required.
-Valid Category B drivers license (minimum) and good driving experience are required.
-Previous cleaning, housekeeping, laundry or equipment maintenance experience is an advantage.
-Additional languages such as Spanish, French, German or Dutch are considered an advantage.

IDEAL PROFILE
-You are practical, reliable, positive and self-disciplined. You are physically ready for active work during a busy winter season, attentive to cleanliness and details, and comfortable working with international guests and colleagues.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Contract type
This is a fixed-term seasonal employment contract. The fixed-term nature is justified by the seasonal peak of the winter travel business in Lapland.

Salary and working hours
Contract type: fixed monthly salary
Starting monthly salary: €2,560 gross
Included working hours: average 37.5–40 hours per week

Supplements
Sunday and official public holiday work is compensated with a 100% pay increase according to Finnish law.
Evening and night work is compensated according to the applicable Program Services Sector Collective

Agreement (Ohjelmapalvelualan TES).
Working time averaging
Due to the seasonal nature of our work, we use a working time averaging arrangement under Finnish law and the applicable collective agreement. Working hours are averaged over the contract period. A work schedule is prepared in advance for each period.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
- Accommodation: a private room in the Levi area can be provided. Rent is €400 per person per month + electricity, under a separate fixed calendar-month lease agreement.
- Work clothing: warm workwear and necessary protective equipment are provided.
- Training: practical onboarding and work-specific training before and during the season.
- Transport: company cars may be used for transport from accommodation to the Levi office according to schedule and availability.
- Connectivity: work phone with a Finnish SIM may be provided depending on work needs.
- Insurance paid by the company: mandatory accident insurance during work, additional free-time accident insurance and additional health insurance.

ADDITIONAL PERKS
- Access to a shared seasonal ski pass for Levi slopes
- Possibility of local Levi fitness club membership
- Local worker discounts at selected restaurants and shops via Levi Passi
- Friendly international team and lively winter season atmosphere

HOW TO APPLY
Please send your CV and additional information in English to hr@gostg.fi.
Subject line: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator — Levi
Please mention your earliest possible start date, relevant experience, language skills and whether you need accommodation in Levi.

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

jobs.title: Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Syngenta

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Hiring Team is seeking a Onsite, Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d) in Münchwilen, Schweiz.

Role purpose:

The role involves leading a team of 1-3 lab technicians in a chemistry lab while being responsible for developing and scaling-up chemical reactions towards manufacturing, including preparation and support of pilot campaigns. The position requires maintaining comprehensive process know-how for all assigned chemical steps. It also demands digital curiosity and confidence, working at the interface of chemistry, data and technology.

Accountabilities:

Ensuring the required HSE standards and good laboratory practices are applied/respected.
Overseeing and defining the experimental program to deliver safe and sustainable chemical processes that are fit for the current development lifecycle stage under guidance of the project lead.
Designing lab experiments and pilot campaigns to generate process understanding and know-how
Maintaining documentation to capture lab results and project requirements as defined by guidance.
Supporting process know-how transfers in agreement with the project lead.
Ensuring close collaboration with project stakeholders.
Supporting the department in specialist roles.
Preparing inputs for cost estimates.
Proposing, supporting, and implementing improvement projects.
Ensuring efficient use of provided resources.
Qualifications
PhD in organic chemistry or chemical engineering, typically with a Post Doc. (or equivalent experience)
Practical experience in organic chemistry.
Fluent English. German and French advantageous.
Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.
Experience in the fields of data science, statistics, modelling, automation or process analytical techniques or in collaborating with experts in these fields.
Basic knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or R or a willingness to learn, is advantageous.
Additional Information
What We Offer

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta’s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)
Please send your complete application with CV, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (80-100%), (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Reporting to the Head of HR Switzerland, you will provide HR Business Partner support to the Technology (R&D) and Service Divisions, as well as selected Corporate Functions including HR, Marketing & Communications and Legal, covering an employee population of around 260. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Attractive compensation & benefits.

Flexible working models.

Employee Assistance Program.

Global parental leave program.

Contract: Permanent contract, full-time position

Define and support integrated rig testing for Avionics and ECS controllers.
Actively support test campaigns by troubleshooting ECS controllers and system integration.
Attend design reviews, technical workshops, and support the team in discussions with Airworthiness Authorities.

Our Ideal Candidate Should Have:
In-depth knowledge of aircraft ECS systems (ATA 21).
Minimum 5 years of experience in aircraft system engineering, focusing on DO-160G, DO-178C, and DO-254 qualification.
Proven ability to prepare and review certification documentation independently.
Strong problem-solving skills and proactive communication abilities.
Fluency in English (minimum B2 level, verbal and written).

If you are a team player, have good communication skills and a problem-solving attitude and want to be part of a growing international engineering company, focus on industrial sector, with opportunities in Europe and USA, then…

SAY YES AND GROW WITH AYES!

jobs.title: Avionics Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Position: Avionics Systems Engineer
Location: Zurich, Switzerland
Contract: Permanent contract, full-time position
Salary: It will be discussed during the recruiting process, taking into consideration seniority and responsibilities within the activity.

AYES is a Switzerland-based Engineering and Technology consulting company headquartered in Baden. Our core business spans several industrial sectors including Automotive, Aerospace, Space & Defense, Railway, Energy, and Life Sciences.
With a strong commitment to innovation and engineering excellence, AYES supports clients across Switzerland, Europe, and the United States through advanced technology development and engineering services.
Our teams work on complex and cutting-edge programs where technical expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential drivers of success.

Key Responsibilities
Capture and analyze system requirements, assessing feasibility and contributing to early system architecture and concept definition
Coordinate the design, development, integration, verification, and certification of complex avionics systems
Support system integration activities and ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations
Prepare and review system requirements documentation and certification engineering reports
Perform and review System Safety Assessments, including Functional Hazard Analysis (FHA) and related safety studies
Interface with external suppliers, customers, procurement teams, and certification authorities on technical matters
Contribute to technology development and innovation initiatives within avionics programs
Provide engineering support to production, integration, and customer support teams when required

Our Ideal Candidate Should Have
University Degree in Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline
Minimum 10 years of experience in aerospace or other safety-critical industries working in systems engineering and avionics development
Proven experience in the design and development of integrated avionics systems
Experience in military aviation environments is considered an advantage
Knowledge of tactical communication systems, datalink technologies (e.g., Link 16), and radar systems is a strong plus
Familiarity with avionics systems such as EFIS, FMS, or Flight Control Systems (FCS)
Exposure to Electronic Warfare (EW), Electronic Countermeasure (ECM), or weapon system integration is beneficial
Working knowledge of FAA, EASA, or military aviation certification frameworks
Fluent English (C1) is required, German language skills are considered an advantage

If you are a detail-oriented communicator with a passion for technical precision, and you want to be part of a growing international engineering company with exciting opportunities in Europe and the USA, then…

SAY YES AND GROW WITH AYES!

jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Kaiseraugst sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Entzugsstation.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Entzugsstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Kaiseraugst

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplompflegefachfrauen und -fachleute HF/FH in der Entzugsbehandlung rund um Kaiseraugst im Aargau ist geprägt von anhaltender hoher Nachfrage, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem anspruchsvollen Bereich knapp sind. Sie haben als qualifizierte Fachperson ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine schnelle Anstellung in etablierten Fachkliniken und Rehabilitationszentren der Region. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbinden, umfassend bei der Bewerbung unterstützen und Ihre Fachkompetenz optimal positionieren.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.
