Vi søger den rette til en attraktiv stilling med stort ansvar for egne projekter, der omhandler udvikling af maskiner inden for landbrug, biomasse og Recycling. Du l indgå i et ungt og dynamisk team, hvor kreativitet og praktisk erfaring er en stor del af jobbet.

Phidan Engineering er en rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed med stor erfaring i udviklingen af moderne landbrugsmaskiner lige fra mejetærsker til jordbearbejdningsmaskiner samt maskiner inden for recycling og biomasse. Ud over konstruktion og beregning rådgiver phidan i test og validering samt opbygning af prototyper på eget værksted.

 

Stillingen omfatter

Opbygning og test at prototyper hvori der indgår alt fra mekanik til hydraulik og styring, du vil være vores medarbejder i marken og på værkstedet, hvor du vil være en stor del af den daglige planlægning af egne opgaver. Du vil få ansvar for egen servicevogn og løse opgaver i direkte samarbejde med kunderne. 

Arbejdsopgaver

·        Udvikling af nye maskiner fra ide til endeligt produkt

·        Opbygning af prototyper

·        Fejlfinding på hydraulik og el tekniske systemer

·        Test og validering af maskiner i samarbejde med udviklingsafdelingen

·        Udviklingsarbejde i ind og udland

jobs.title: Assisterende serviceleder til Aarhus – er du god til mennesker og har blik for kvalitet?
jobs.description:
Vil du have en hverdag, hvor du er tæt på medarbejderne, følger op på kvaliteten og er med til at få den daglige drift til at fungere?

Vi søger en assisterende serviceleder til Aarhus-området, som trives med ansvar, mennesker og en arbejdsdag, hvor du er meget ude i driften.

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen, primært om eftermiddagen og aftenen. Du møder typisk omkring kl. 14.30, men arbejdstiden kan variere.

Din hverdag hos os

Du bliver en vigtig støtte for både medarbejdere og ledelse. Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • føre tilsyn og følge op på kvaliteten hos vores kunder

  • oplære, instruere og følge op på medarbejdere

  • sikre, at medarbejderne har de rette rammer for at løse deres opgaver

  • reagere på de udfordringer, der opstår i den daglige drift

  • hjælpe med mindre administrative opgaver, bl.a. i forbindelse med løn

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er god til at skabe relationer og naturligt tager ansvar. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket og kommunikere tydeligt med forskellige mennesker.

Erfaring fra rengøring, service eller en lignende rolle er en fordel, men for os er din tilgang til mennesker og kvalitet mindst lige så vigtig.

Du skal have kørekort B.

Det får du hos Toma

Du får en selvstændig og varieret stilling med stor kontakt til medarbejderne og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i hverdagen.

Hos Toma lægger vi vægt på ordentlighed, ansvarlighed og god service – både over for vores kunder og hinanden.

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring. 

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Ansøgningsfrist: 1. september

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter gerne, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV til mail: job@toma-as.dk – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center)
jobs.description:
**About us**

Established in 2006, Nordecon Oy is a multinational OEM company and solution provider specializing in complex end-to-end mobile, server, and custom-built desktop solutions. With nearly two decades of experience and a strong track record in delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions, the company is pivoting towards new opportunities. We are building a modern AI-focused Data Center in Finland designed for high-density GPU computing. Our infrastructure is being built from the ground up, giving you the opportunity to influence every aspect of the network architecture instead of maintaining legacy systems.

We are looking for an experienced Network & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing, building and operating reliable infrastructure.

**What you will do**

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating the entire network infrastructure of the data center.

This role combines architecture, implementation and day-to-day technical ownership.

**Network Architecture**

- Design the complete data center network from the ground up.

- Develop scalable and resilient network architecture.

- Design physical fibre topology.

- Design IP addressing strategy.

- Design VLAN and VRF structure.

- Design rack connectivity standards.

- Produce and maintain network documentation.

- Plan future expansion of the infrastructure.


**External Connectivity**

- Design and maintain multi-ISP connectivity.

- Configure and operate BGP.

- Design Internet redundancy and failover.

- Coordinate network connectivity with providers.

- Plan future interconnection between multiple data center locations.


**Internal Network**

- Deploy and maintain switches, routers and firewalls.

- Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.

- Build management and out-of-band networks.

- Maintain network security.

- Troubleshoot complex networking issues.

- Support high-speed Ethernet environments (25G / 100G / 400G).


**Monitoring & Automation**

- Build network monitoring and alerting.

- Integrate infrastructure into monitoring platforms.

- Automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Maintain accurate documentation.

- Improve operational reliability.


**Infrastructure Integration**

Work closely with electrical and mechanical contractors to integrate infrastructure into a unified monitoring platform.

Examples include:

- UPS

- Generators

- Cooling systems

- Water pumps

- Fire detection systems

- Environmental monitoring

- Building Management System (BMS)


Experience with Modbus, BACnet or similar industrial protocols is an advantage but **not required**.

**Required Skills**

- Strong networking knowledge.

- Experience designing and deploying enterprise or data center networks.

- Cisco, Juniper, Arista or similar platforms.

- TCP/IP.

- BGP.

- OSPF.

- VLAN.

- LACP.

- Linux administration.

- Fibre networking.

- Excellent troubleshooting skills.

- Good documentation practices.

- Ability to independently deliver technical projects.


**Nice to Have**

- EVPN / VXLAN.

- Spine-Leaf architectures.

- Network automation.

- Python.

- Ansible.

- Grafana.

- Prometheus.

- Zabbix.

- GPU cluster networking.

- AI/HPC infrastructure.

- Kubernetes.

- Docker.

- Modbus.

- BACnet.


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure rather than simply maintaining existing environments.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions, designing solutions from scratch and implementing them yourself.

You don't need to know everything. We value strong networking fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

**What we offer**

- Opportunity to build a modern AI Data Center from the ground up.

- Freedom to influence technical decisions.

- Modern infrastructure.

- High level of technical ownership.

- Long-term career growth.

- Competitive salary based on experience.


**Work Setup**

Location: Riihimäki, Finland (hybrid work possible but on-site presence required at times)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience. Start: As soon as a suitable candidate is found but the start date is flexible.

**Interested?**

Send your CV, short introduction, and salary request to **applications@nordecon.fi**.

If you have questions, feel free to reach out, were happy to discuss the role in more detail.

**Please note:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond individually to each applicant. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: YHTEISÖVALMENTAJAN SIJAINEN AMMATILLISEEN KOULUTUKSEEN
jobs.description:
Perho Liiketalousopisto on koulutusalojemme työnantajien perustama ammatillinen oppilaitos. Toimimme Helsingissä kolmella hyvin saavutettavalla kampuksella: Malmilla, Töölössä ja Urhea-kampuksella (Mäkelänrinteessä). Perhossa opiskellaan palvelualojen bisnestä, ja meiltä valmistuu taitavia ammattilaisia ravintola-, matkailu- ja luontoalan sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin. Olemme myös urheiluoppilaitos ja tuemme tavoitteellisen urheilun ja opiskelun sujuvaa yhdistämistä. Monipuolisia oppimisympäristöjämme täydentävät mm. digikampuksemme sekä Perhon ravintolat, Green City Farm -kaupunkipelto, Perhon Panimo ja Juustola sekä Helmi Center -liikuntakeskus (www.perho.fi [http://www.perho.fi])

Perho kantaa pitkälle – se on lupauksemme perholaisille opiskelijoille ja työyhteisömme jäsenille! Perhon työyhteisössä on aikaansaava yhdessä tekemisen meininki. Työyhteisömme rakentuu eri alojen asiantuntijoista, jotka kannustavat toisiaan ja joiden kaikkien ääntä kuunnellaan. Perholaiset onnistuvat yhdessä!

Vakinaisen yhteisövalmentajamme toimivapaan myötä haemme nyt yhteisövalmentajan sijaista määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 21.9.-18.12.2026 väliselle ajalle.

Pääset työskentelemään Malmin ja Töölön kampuksillamme Perhon perustutkinto-opiskelijoiden parissa monipuolisissa toimintaympäristöissä. Päätehtävänäsi on aktivoida opiskelijoita liikkumaan, pelaamaan ja viettämään yhteistä aikaa oppituntien ulkopuolella sekä tutustuttamaan heitä yhteisöllisiin tiloihimme ja mahdollisuuksiin kampusympäristöissämme. Opiskelijoita aktivoivat ja ryhmähenkeä lisäävät tapahtumat ovat myös yhteisövalmentajan työpöydällä.

Opiskelijoiden lisäksi pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti opetushenkilöstön ja opiskeluhuoltoryhmän kanssa aktiivisen ja liikkuvan arjen edistämisessä sekä opiskelijoiden hyvinvoinnin tukemisessa.

Me odotamme sinulta

* tehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa - esimerkiksi yhteisöpedagogi, sosionomi tai kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perus- tai ammattitutkinto

* kokemusta nuorten kohtaamisesta ja työskentelystä heidän kanssaan

* hyvää yhteistyökykyä ja kokemusta ryhmätoiminnasta

* hyviä suullisia vuorovaikutusvalmiuksia

* aktiivista ja liikunnallista asennetta

* oma-aloitteista, itsenäistä ja innostavaa työotetta, valmiutta ja halua sitoutua perholaisiin arvoihin: rohkea, vastuullinen, palveleva ja innostava. Monikulttuurinen osaaminen katsotaan hakijalle eduksi.

Me tarjoamme sinulle

* monipuolisen ja haastavan tehtävänkuvan

* viihtyisän ja hyvinvointia edistävän työympäristön

* mahdollisuuden omaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen

* Perho Liiketalousopiston ammatillisen koulutuksen kokemuksen ja edelläkävijyyden.

Palkka ja työsuhteen muut ehdot määräytyvät yksityistä opetusalaa koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja siihen vaikuttavat valittavan hakijan tutkinto- ja osaamistausta sekä aikaisempi työkokemus. Työehtosopimuksen mukainen työaika on 36 h 15 min. / vko.

jobs.title: Emission Measurement Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Emission Measurement Engineer to strengthen the Emissions & Automation team in ourTesting & Validation Test Services. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, and the work is carried out at the Sustainable Technology Hub (STH) in Vaskiluoto.

Your role and responsibilities

We operate in the STH Plant, close to the test cells in the Hub and Research Lab. We strive to continuously improve our measurement methods and maintain our equipment in top condition. Youll be working as part of a dedicated team with diverse expertise.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Carry out emission measurements in STH on production engines, test engines, and single-cylinder research engines
* Be part of a team developing new methods for emission measurements and continue the ongoing work of automating recurring emission measurements
* Develop your knowledge and expertise in the emission measurement area in the longer term, to also cover fuel gas analysis, measurement of particulates, and/or other more advanced methods
* Perform maintenance and calibration of the emission measurement equipment



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Relevant technical education (BSc or MSc, or equivalent, in Chemical, Environmental, Automation, or Electrical Engineering)
* Good understanding of technology and product development – knowledge of the Wärtsilä engine product family, systems, and solutions is seen as a benefit
* Strong internal motivation, passion for execution, and drive to get things completed
* Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Good teamwork skills
* Proactive and self-driven approach with a doers attitude
* Good English skills; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage
* Structured way of working and planning
* Willingness to learn and adapt



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out to Staffan Nysand, Manager, Emissions & Automation, through staffan.nysand@wartsila.com or by phone at +358 50 534 3944 with any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications submitted via email will not be recorded or responded to).

Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Solutions Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas â unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space.

Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals.

Including, but not limited to:

  • Navigate a budding product area through to market adoption â partnering with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and shape our vision in this space

Â 

QUALIFICATIONS

    • Knowledge of Benchlingâs Platform and solutions, and technical proficiency with Benchling products is preferred

  • Customer Readiness

    • Experienced customer experience professional with a strong track record in overseeing the success of customer engagements

    • Superior customer service skills â the ability to be empathetic, accurate, resourceful, and conscientious with a sense of urgency

  • Problem Solving and Collaborative Success

    • Excellent oral and written communication skills to work effectively with others both inside and outside departmental boundaries, at remote locations and/or outside the company

    • Demonstrate ability to analyze and resolve complex problems and rapidly assimilate new knowledge and information

    • Flexible and able to adjust on the fly to new demands; a high sense of urgency, tendency towards action, and comfortable working through ambiguity to independently make progress on individual and team goals

  • Experience and Educational Requirements

    • 2+ years experience in customer service or customer-facing roles

    • Bachelor's degree in chemistry, or life sciences related field is required (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.)

jobs.title: Global Technology Specialist, BESS
jobs.description:
Region Nordjylland

Har du dokumenteret erfaring med BESS, teknisk drift, performance optimering og sikkerhed? Vi søger en erfaren Global Technology Specialist, BESS til vores kunde i Region Nordjylland, hvor du vil få en central teknisk rolle med ansvar for drift, optimering og sikkerhed på tværs af BESS sites.

Om stillingen

Som Global Technology Specialist, BESS bliver du teknisk nøgleperson inden for Battery Energy Storage Systems.

Du får en senior specialistrolle, hvor du skal sikre sikker, stabil og effektiv drift af BESS anlæg. Rollen kræver både dyb teknisk forståelse, praktisk driftserfaring og evnen til at samarbejde på tværs af tekniske og ikke tekniske interessenter.

  • Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Teknisk drift af BESS anlæg
    Du overvåger og understøtter den daglige drift af BESS systemer og bidrager til stabil og sikker performance.

  • Fejlfinding og performance optimering
    Du arbejder med alarmer, teknisk fejlfinding, dataanalyse og optimering af anlæggenes drift.

  • Vedligehold og teknisk prioritering
    Du planlægger, prioriterer og følger op på planlagt og korrigerende vedligehold, både remote og onsite.

  • Sikkerhed, risiko og beredskab
    Du bidrager til risikovurderinger, sikkerhedsprocedurer og beredskabsplaner i samarbejde med relevante funktioner.

  • Leverandørstyring og tekniske krav
    Du samarbejder med leverandører, servicepartnere og interne projektteams samt bidrager til tekniske krav, lessons learned og forbedringer til kommende projekter.

Du får en rolle med stor teknisk indflydelse, hvor du skal kunne tage ejerskab, træffe beslutninger og skabe struktur i et komplekst teknisk miljø.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Relevant teknisk uddannelse
    Du har minimum bachelor niveau inden for engineering, el, energi, automation, power systems eller tilsvarende teknisk område.

  • Dokumenteret BESS erfaring
    Du har praktisk erfaring med Battery Energy Storage Systems og forstår teknologien i en driftsmæssig kontekst.

  • Hands on erfaring med teknisk drift
    Du har arbejdet med drift, fejlfinding, vedligehold og performance optimering af tekniske systemer.

  • Stærk forståelse for sikkerhed og risiko
    Du har erfaring med sikkerhedsprocedurer, risikostyring og regulatoriske krav i tekniske miljøer.

  • Erfaring med leverandørstyring
    Du kan samarbejde med eksterne servicepartnere, leverandører og tekniske specialister.

  • Erfaring med teknisk projektledelse
    Du kan planlægge, prioritere og følge op på tekniske opgaver på tværs af interessenter.

  • Flydende engelsk
    Du kommunikerer professionelt på engelsk i både skrift og tale. Dansk er en fordel.

Som person er du teknisk stærk, selvstændig og beslutningsdygtig. Du arbejder struktureret, er vedholdende i fejlfinding og kan kommunikere klart med både teknikere, ledelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

jobs.title: Coordinateur Maintenance Site (H/F)
jobs.description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader of paper-based packaging solutions. With more than 100,000 employees, 500 converting operations, and 59 mills across 40 countries, we provide our customers with an expansive range of distinctive, innovative products. Learn more about how we're creating the future of packaging together.

Le poste :

SMURFIT WESTROCK Distribution Vin (SWDV) déploie sa compétence packaging auprès du marché de la viticulture au bénéfice des plus belles appellations de Gironde - Saint Emilion, Pessac, Médoc et pour ses autres clients en France.
Avec 30 collaborateurs spécialistes engagés, cette filiale du groupe international SMURFIT WESTROCK, déploie un processus complet de transformation du carton et de Supply Chain pour proposer des produits sur-mesure toujours plus innovants pour leurs clients, et meilleurs pour la planète (#BetterPlanetPackaging).
Dans le cadre d'un remplacement, VECTEUR HUMAIN, Cabinet régional indépendant expert en Approche directe & RH, recrute pour son partenaire SWDV basé à Beychac-et-Caillau (33), son futur(e) : Coordinateur Maintenance Site F/H.
Au sein du site SMURFIT WESTROCK Distribution Vin, vous êtes en charge de garantir le bon fonctionnement et l'amélioration de l'outil de production et des services généraux.
Rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement au Directeur de site, vous mettez en oeuvre les actions de maintenance nécessaires à la réalisation des objectifs de performance du site en déployant la stratégie de l'entreprise dans le respect des valeurs du Groupe et de ses spécificités régionales.
Dans cette structure industrielle moderne, exigeante, visant l'excellence industrielle avec un environnement de santé et sécurité optimal, voici un aperçu « non exhaustif » de vos activités :
En support de l'atelier de production - impression, façonnage et montage, vous :

- Assurez la maintenance et le dépannage courant des organes mécaniques, pneumatiques, hydrauliques, électriques et automatismes ; Recherches de pannes, remplacements d'éléments, remises en état, mécanique industrielle.
- Réalisez les maintenances planifiées et effectuez des contrôles réglementaires ;
- Améliorez la performance des équipements de production et notamment la performance énergétique ;
- Proposez des améliorations du matériel - fiabilité, productivité ;
- Échangez avec les conducteurs pour restituer votre intervention et recommandez les bonnes pratiques d'utilisation et maintenance de 1er niveau ;
- Gérez la documentation technique et les pièces détachées, approvisionnez les stocks de consommables ;
- Ponctuellement auprès de nos clients locaux, vous intervenez sur des machines similaires aux nôtres mises à leur disposition.

Pour l'ensemble du site, vous :

- Pilotez des prestataires de tous corps de métiers : fournisseurs de machines, intervenant en maintenance ou travaux neuf, entretien du parc chariot élévateurs, sécurité incendie et bâtiment ;
- Suivez le budget et la facturation des intervenants, pièces, consommables ;
- Assurez le suivi des contrôles périodiques réglementaires (chariots élévateurs, racks') en lien avec le préventeur santé sécurité et le directeur de site ;
- Participerez à l'implantation de nouvelles machines et installations ou à leur évolution (ajouts de fonctionnalités, évolutions réglementaires) ;
- Êtes le garant de la sécurité de vos chantiers et des interventions externes dans le respect des protocoles de consignation et de sécurisation du Groupe - plans de prévention, permis feu, travail en hauteur?



Profil recherché :

De formation technique de niveau Bac à Bac+2 en Maintenance industrielle, Électrotechnique ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience professionnelle significative en maintenance industrielle.
Une expérience des services généraux constituerait un véritable atout.
Vous avez évolué à des fonctions de Coordinateur de maintenance, Gestionnaire de maintenance, Technicien de maintenance ou Électromécanicien expérimenté, vous ayant permis de développer une solide vision opérationnelle des activités de maintenance et de fiabilisation des équipements industriels.
Vous disposez de solides compétences techniques en mécanique, électromécanique, hydraulique et pneumatique, ainsi que d'une bonne maîtrise des méthodes et processus de maintenance. À l'aise avec les outils informatiques, vous utilisez quotidiennement une GMAO et savez assurer le suivi des interventions, piloter des entreprises sous-traitantes et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la performance des installations.
Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation et votre capacité d'analyse, vous savez diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements, identifier les solutions les plus adaptées et être force de proposition dans une logique de fiabilisation des équipements.
Votre autonomie et votre sens du service vous permettent d'intervenir efficacement auprès des équipes de production tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de sécurité, de qualité...

jobs.title: Technical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Region Nordjylland

Er du stærk inden for drift og vedligehold af elektriske anlæg, og har du erfaring med SCADA, mellemspænding eller højspænding? Vi søger en engageret Technical Operations Specialist til vores kunde i Region Nordjylland, hvor du vil spille en central rolle i sikker, stabil og effektiv drift af elektriske assets og BESS anlæg.

Om stillingen

Som Technical Operations Specialist bliver du en del af en teknisk driftsfunktion, hvor du skal arbejde med drift, vedligehold, overvågning og sikker håndtering af elektriske net og installationer.

Rollen kræver en person med solid elteknisk forståelse, som kan tage ansvar i driftskritiske situationer og samtidig arbejde struktureret med dokumentation, sikkerhed og koordinering.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Drift af elektriske anlæg
    Du arbejder med drift af elektriske net, elektriske installationer og tekniske assets, primært via SCADA systemer.

  • Planlægning af vedligehold og udkoblinger
    Du planlægger og koordinerer udkoblinger i forbindelse med planlagt vedligehold og arbejde på eller nær elektriske installationer.

  • Fejlretning og teknisk fejlanalyse
    Du håndterer tekniske hændelser, fejl og korrigerende handlinger i samarbejde med interne og eksterne parter.

  • Koblingsplaner, risikovurderinger og arbejdstilladelser
    Du udarbejder og følger op på koblingsplaner, risikovurderinger og arbejdstilladelser med fokus på sikker drift.

  • Samarbejde og teknisk koordinering
    Du samarbejder med asset management, servicepartnere, leverandører, netselskaber, EPC organisationer og SCADA specialister.

Du får en rolle med høj grad af selvstændighed, hvor din tekniske dømmekraft, sikkerhedsforståelse og evne til at skabe struktur bliver afgørende.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Stærk elteknisk baggrund
    Eksempelvis som ingeniør, maskinmester, autoriseret elinstallatør, stærkstrømstekniker eller tilsvarende.

  • Erfaring med elektrisk drift
    Du har erfaring med drift og vedligehold af elektriske anlæg, gerne inden for mellemspænding eller højspænding.

  • Erfaring med SCADA eller teknisk overvågning
    Du har arbejdet med overvågning af elektriske assets og kan reagere struktureret på alarmer, fejl og driftsafvigelser.

  • Forståelse for elektrisk sikkerhed
    Du har erfaring med koblingsplaner, arbejdstilladelser, risikovurderinger og sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Interesse for BESS
    Du har interesse for eller erfaring med Battery Energy Storage Systems og ønsker at arbejde med fremtidens energiinfrastruktur.

  • Dokumentationsforståelse
    Du kan arbejde struktureret med teknisk dokumentation, vedligeholdelsesgrundlag og operationelle processer.

  • Professionelt engelsk
    Du kan kommunikere på engelsk i teknisk sammenhæng. Dansk er en fordel.

Som person er du teknisk stærk, sikkerhedsbevidst og struktureret. Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og trives i en rolle, hvor fejl, drift og sikkerhed skal håndteres med ro og præcision.

Arbejdssted og praktiske forhold

Det primære arbejdssted er i Region Nordjylland.

Rollen vil primært være kontorbaseret i en teknisk driftsfunktion, men der kan forekomme onsite aktiviteter på elektriske anlæg og BESS faciliteter i Danmark.

Sikkerhedsgodkendelse kan blive påkrævet.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En teknisk stærk rolle med ansvar
    Du får en central rolle i drift og vedligehold af elektriske anlæg og BESS assets.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
    Du får mulighed for at arbejde med eldrift, SCADA, sikkerhed, dokumentation og nye energiteknologier.

  • Et dynamisk teknisk miljø
    Du bliver en del af en organisation med fokus på driftssikkerhed, samarbejde og grøn energi.

  • Indflydelse på processer og optimering
    Du får mulighed for at bidrage til digitalisering, optimering og forbedring af operationelle processer.

jobs.title: Housekeeper
jobs.description:
**Housekeepers for the Winter Season 2026–2027 in Levi, Ylläs and Sodankylä!**

We are looking for enthusiastic seasonal employees for a variety of accommodation destinations in Levi, Ylläs and Sodankylä! How would you like to work in an international environment as part of an energetic and supportive team that values and respects one another?

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace**

N-Clean has been recognized in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-centered and responsible workplace. In 2024, we were awarded Finlands Most Human-Centered Workplace, and in 2025, we achieved third place in both the overall competition and the Most Human-Centered Working Life Act category. These recognitions highlight our people-focused recruitment approach, where respect, meaningful interactions and a positive candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do. Our values – **trust, respect and commitment** – are reflected in our daily work through concrete actions: we keep our promises, take pride in our work and treat each other fairly. Everyone at N-Clean is responsible for their own work and for our shared success. We support one another, even during the busiest times.

**Housekeeper (Hotels and Other Accommodation Properties)**

As a Housekeeper, you are responsible for ensuring that guest rooms, apartments and cabins are clean, comfortable and welcoming. Through your work, you help maintain high quality standards and directly contribute to customer satisfaction with your attention to detail and commitment to excellent service. During the winter season, working hours vary depending on the property. Most shifts are morning shifts ending in the afternoon. Work is available on both weekdays and weekends. In this role, you will perform visible and meaningful work that has a direct impact on guests daily experiences, holidays and overall comfort. You play an important part in creating a successful customer experience. Your workday follows a planned schedule, and you are responsible for ensuring your tasks are completed efficiently, while working together with your team to achieve shared goals. The role requires initiative, planning skills, efficiency and the ability to follow agreed schedules. Quality, safety and friendly customer service are essential parts of everyday work. Completing tasks carefully according to quality and safety standards and interacting with guests in a professional and friendly manner are key aspects of the role. You enjoy a fast-paced work environment, customer service and working effectively in changing situations. Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning hotel rooms, apartments and cabins, including changing linens, making beautiful beds, cleaning bathrooms, cleaning various floor surfaces, wiping surfaces and replenishing room supplies.

- Cleaning public areas, apartment kitchens, cabin kitchens and/or meeting facilities.

- Additional cleaning tasks such as window cleaning.

- **You may also have the opportunity to assist in the heart of the hotel by helping with breakfast service**


**What We Offer**

- A fixed-term part-time employment contract (20–31 hours per week) from November to March. Employment start dates are staggered throughout November and December.

- Varied morning shifts and, in Ylläs, evening/night shifts from 5:00 PM to 11:30 PM.

- A thorough introduction through our renewed onboarding journey and N-Clean Academy. Previous experience in the industry is not required, although it may help you get started more quickly.

- The opportunity to continue working with us after the season.

- Salary according to the Collective Agreement for the Property Services Industry: €11.33–€13.88/hour depending on your duties.

- A genuinely caring work community and supportive supervisors. At N-Clean, seasonal work is more than just a job. It is an opportunity to learn new skills, gain valuable work experience and become part of a community where every contribution is noticed and appreciated.


**What We Expect from You**

- You have a positive and energetic attitude and approach your work with enthusiasm and curiosity. You are eager to learn, complete your tasks carefully and maintain high quality while following agreed schedules.

- You work proactively and with a solution-focused mindset and can handle situations independently. Physical work and varied workdays do not intimidate you; instead, you enjoy being active.

- You are service-minded, flexible and act according to our values in everyday situations. Reliability and a responsible work ethic are reflected in the way you work.

- You work well as part of a team but are also comfortable working independently within your own area of responsibility. Finnish and/or English language skills are required.

- You speak either Finnish or English.

- A driving licence and access to a car will be considered an advantage.

- Please note that if you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit for Finland.


For us, the most important qualities are the right attitude and a willingness to complete work to a high standard, on time and in line with our values. We learn together and support one another so everyone can succeed in their role. You enjoy physical work, take responsibility for your own tasks and complete them with quality and punctuality. You are comfortable working independently and managing your own responsibilities.

**Diversity and Equality**

Our workforce includes people from more than 100 nationalities. We actively promote equality and inclusion and want everyone to feel valued and welcome. Different backgrounds, life situations and experiences are a strength for us.

**Apply Now!**

Submit your application through our website no later than 13 September 2026.

jobs.title: Director, Projects, Marine
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced engineering professional with a passion for leading people and delivering high-quality project execution? Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with team leadership and close collaboration with sales and clients? Would you like to be part of a global engineering and consulting organization, working across international teams and projects to deliver solutions for the marine industry?

If so, this could be your next career step.

Your role and the team

Join us as we strengthen our Project Operations team of ten professionals! The team is part of our Marine business unit, ensuring our projects are executed successfully as well as providing high-end project execution services for our clients. The team also supports project sales and business development.

As a Director, you will play a key role in overseeing our project portfolio and working as a Marine Business Unit PMO, managing and developing our project operations, ensuring efficient, high-quality project execution aligned with our long-term business goals and processes. You shall be responsible for building our project management capability, leading and supporting the current team in a daily leadership role and contributing hands-on to projects when needed.

You will also drive business growth by identifying new opportunities, building customer relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. In addition, you will contribute to recruitment, subcontracting decisions, and the development of expertise within your team and discipline.

As the Marine PMO, you will be working closely with the Elomatic Group PMO to ensure our project management processes are aligned and further developed according to business needs. You'll also work closely with sales to provide engineering and technology support, contribute to proposals, and strengthen client relationships. Additionally, you play a key role in ensuring effective collaboration between internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle, from initial sales activities to successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project management professional with hands-on senior project management experience in the marine industry. You are motivated to drive successful projects by leading people and actively contributing to project delivery while working closely with customers. jobs.title: Landmåler Anlæg / Forsyning
jobs.description:
Nordjylland

Er du landmåler med erfaring fra anlægsprojekter, kloak, forsyning, rør i jord eller byggemodning? Vi søger en selvstændig og præcis landmåler til vores kunde i Nordjylland, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af projektteamet omkring afsætning, opmåling, kontrol og dokumentation.

Om stillingen

Som Landmåler Anlæg / Forsyning skal du understøtte projektleder og formand på anlægsprojekter i Nordjylland.

Din rolle bliver at sikre, at afsætning, opmåling og dokumentation er korrekt, så udførelsen kan ske effektivt og uden unødige fejl i marken.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Afsætning på anlægsprojekter
    Du udfører afsætning i forbindelse med kloak, rør i jord, byggemodning og øvrige anlægsarbejder.

  • Opmåling og kontrolmålinger
    Du foretager opmålinger og kontrolmålinger, så projektteamet har et præcist grundlag at arbejde ud fra.

  • Dokumentation af udført arbejde
    Du sikrer korrekt dokumentation og bidrager til kvalitetssikring og aflevering.

  • Samarbejde med formand og projektleder
    Du arbejder tæt sammen med formand om den daglige udførelse og understøtter projektleder med mængder, registreringer og teknisk overblik.

  • Digitale værktøjer og tegningsforståelse
    Du arbejder med landmålingsudstyr, anlægstegninger, digitale registreringer og relevante systemer til dokumentation.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Relevant teknisk baggrund
    Eksempelvis som landmåler, kort og landmålingstekniker, teknisk designer, anlægstekniker eller tilsvarende praktisk erfaring.

  • Erfaring med anlægslandmåling
    Du har erfaring med landmåling på anlægsprojekter og trives med at arbejde ude på site.

  • Erfaring med kloak, forsyning eller rør i jord
    Du har forståelse for, hvordan opmåling og afsætning understøtter den praktiske udførelse.

  • Styr på dokumentation
    Du kan levere præcis og brugbar dokumentation af udført arbejde.

  • Digitalt stærk
    Du har erfaring med GPS, totalstation eller tilsvarende udstyr og kan arbejde struktureret med digitale data.

  • God samarbejdsevne
    Du kan samarbejde tæt med formand, projektleder og udførende folk på pladsen.

Som person er du præcis, selvstændig og grundig. Du trives med ansvar, har blik for detaljer og forstår, at fejl i opmåling og dokumentation hurtigt kan blive dyre fejl i projektet.

Arbejdssted og praktiske forhold

Arbejdsstedet er i Nordjylland, hvor du primært vil arbejde onsite på anlægsprojekter.

Der vil være tæt samarbejde med projektleder og formand, og du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt på flere opgaver efter behov.

Opstart aftales nærmere.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En vigtig teknisk rolle i projektteamet
    Du bliver en central del af udførelsen og kvalitetssikringen på anlægsprojekterne.

  • Praktisk ansvar tæt på projekterne
    Du får mulighed for at arbejde hands on med afsætning, opmåling og dokumentation.

  • Mulighed for længerevarende tilknytning
    Der er tale om en rolle med potentiale for fast eller længerevarende samarbejde.

  • Et stærkt samarbejde med projektleder og formand
    Du bliver en del af et team, hvor præcision, fremdrift og kvalitet er afgørende.

Opstart

Efter aftale

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker at finde den rette kandidat hurtigst muligt.

Nordjysk Projektledelse er et specialiseret projektlederhus, der hjælper virksomheder med at styrke deres projektorganisation gennem erfarne og kompetente projektledere, formænd, landmålere og tekniske profiler.

Vi leverer fleksible løsninger ved spidsbelastninger, strategiske projekter og midlertidige ressourcemangler.

Hos Nordjysk Projektledelse vægter vi faglighed, ansvarlighed og stærke samarbejdsrelationer.

jobs.title: Formand Anlæg / Forsyning

jobs.title: Professor/ Associate Professor in Public Health
jobs.description:
Om Aarhus UniversitetAarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.000 studerende og 8.700 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,3 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

The Department of Public Health at the Faculty of Health Sciences, Aarhus University, invites applications for a position at the level of full Professor or Associate Professor. The expected start date is January 1st 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

The candidate will contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities within innovation and collaboration by building innovation capacity and developing collaboration with external parties. The candidate will be part of an innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem at Aarhus University (AU). AU is currently strengthening its strategic efforts within innovation and entrepreneurship. This effort is a direct extension of AU’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship constitute a central strategic focus area. With the aim of expanding AU’s capacity to link research and innovation, the university leadership has decided to create a number of new research and innovation positions across the university. The newly created positions are intended to help integrate an innovation mindset into the university culture, while at the same time producing concrete, visible impact and societal benefit.

About the Department
The Department of Public Health is research-intensive and has a strong international and collaborative orientation. Our research spans theoretical, basic, and applied sciences, with the goal of generating impactful knowledge and improving population health. We are built on a foundation of academic excellence, and we are committed to conducting rigorous, innovative, high-quality teaching. The department is responsible for teaching at public health science, sports science, nursing science, health science, and for a significant part of teaching in the medicine program.

We are firmly rooted in our academic disciplines and actively foster interdisciplinary collaboration to drive innovation and excellence in both research and teaching. We are committed to fostering a healthy and inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, open communication, and an informal tone. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
The successful candidate will strengthen the department’s research, innovation and research-based teaching within health services research and contribute to the academic development at Aarhus University and to the university’s profile both nationally and internationally.

Your main tasks are expected to include:

* Actively contribute to the faculty community and support the faculty´s ambitions for innovation and collaboration.

* Lead your own innovation projects and facilitate the translation of research findings into practical solutions.

* Identify innovation potential within the research environments.

* Expanding your research activities by securing external funding and thus contributing to the department’s strategic goals.

* Increase local awareness and visibility of innovation initiatives.

* Implement initiatives decided by the faculty leadership and the dean’s office.

* Teaching and supervising students within innovation

* Supervising PhD students

* Participating in academic assessment and committee work at Aarhus University.

* Disseminating your research to both academic and broader audiences

You will report to the Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard.

Your competences

You have established yourself as a prominent researcher within your scientific field and can document research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have a network of international partners, experience in attracting significant research funding from national and international funding bodies, and a potential of becoming a skilled research leader. In the hiring process, we place particular emphasis on professional experience gained through employment or extended research stays at internationally recognized universities or research institutions outside the candidate’s primary place of employment.

We particularly value documented experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Public Health services research

* Artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced analytics in healthcare

* Health economic, public health policy, and leadership in healthcare organizations

* Digital transformation and applied data driven decision making in public health organizations

* Cross-sectoral collaboration across health organizations

* A strong record of securing external funding for interdisciplinary and collaborative research projects

The successful candidate has a strong international network and demonstrated experience in interdisciplinary collaboration across health services research, digital health and leadership.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications. Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard tel.: (+45) 4022 7649. Your place of work will be the Department of Public Health, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Terms of employment - professor


  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.


  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor


  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.


  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment


  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.


  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).


  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.


  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.


  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - associate professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.



International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: PhD Position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a more sustainable built environment to apply for a PhD position in 3D Concrete Printing for Low-Carbon Buildings. The position is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 23:59 CET/CEST.

 

Scope of the work

The PhD position is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. The overall ambition is to develop a new generation of low-carbon prefabricated building systems enabled by 3D concrete printing, rethinking how concrete structures are designed, fabricated, and assembled.

The research will bring together architectural design, structural optimisation, and artificial intelligence to generate materially efficient building systems in which geometry, structural performance, and fabrication are developed as an integrated whole. It will address advanced toolpath generation, reinforcement integration, structural connections, and assembly through unified computational design and robotic fabrication workflows.

The candidate will develop artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting structural evaluation, geometry generation, fabrication planning, and robotic production. The work will combine computational research with extensive laboratory experimentation, including the robotic printing of full-scale components and building demonstrators at SDU CREATE and their validation through structural testing.

The candidate will also contribute to teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through laboratory teaching, workshops, and co-supervision of student projects.

 

Focus Area and Research Project

The research focuses on developing the next generation of low-carbon building systems. 3D concrete printing offers significant opportunities for prefabrication, geometric differentiation, and project-specific optimisation. Realising this potential requires an integrated approach in which architectural design, structural performance, robotic fabrication, reinforcement, connections, and assembly are addressed as interdependent aspects of a building system.

The project will develop computational and experimental methods for the design, fabrication, and validation of materially efficient prefabricated building systems. It will extend SDU CREATE’s research on performance-informed architectural design, structural optimisation, hybrid printing, reinforcement integration, and full-scale robotic construction.

The research will address the following areas:

  • Computational design of architecturally and structurally integrated prefabricated building systems for 3DCP

  • Structural optimisation at component and system levels, encompassing slabs, beams, columns, walls, nodes, and their connections

  • Artificial intelligence-driven pipelines connecting geometry generation, structural evaluation, and fabrication planning

  • Advanced toolpath generation and sensing-based process control for structurally differentiated components

  • Integration of reinforcement, structural connections, fabrication constraints, and assembly requirements into robotic production workflows

  • Robotic 3D printing of full-scale components and construction of integrated building demonstrators

  • Structural testing of printed components, connections, and assembled systems

  • Quantitative evaluation of material consumption, embodied carbon, structural performance, and production efficiency

 

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, with a focus on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation.  SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable and regenerative approaches to the design and production of the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, concrete mixing and extrusion equipment, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full-scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads the research field on Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to the research field on Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

 

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication and structural testing experiments, including direct operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

The candidate’s engagement in these activities will evolve with their growing experience, contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally toward future career advancement.

 

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, civil or architectural engineering, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in the research area of 3D Concrete Printing

  • Advanced competence in Grasshopper and Rhino. Knowledge of Python, C#, or finite element analysis is evaluated positively

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document, and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Experience with hands-on and experimental lab and construction activities 

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams, coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written, and oral formats

  • Beneficial experience in teaching assistance or peer-reviewed publications

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects

  • Engagement with academic or industry stakeholders in relevant domains

 

Contact Information

For further information about this position and SDU CREATE's activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre´s work, visit the website at www.create-sdu.com. If you encounter technical issues during the application process, please contact our email support.

 

Application Procedure

Applicants are advised to carefully read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and 

how to apply for academic staff before submitting their application. The application must be submitted in English and include the following documents, uploaded in the specified order as PDF files:

  1. Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. The form is available on the Faculty website.

  2. Motivation letter and research statement, with a maximum combined length of five pages. The document should clearly describe the applicant’s proposed research direction and qualifications for the position.

  3. Detailed curriculum vitae, including academic and professional experience, research projects, teaching and supervision experience, awards, exhibitions, and computational and fabrication skills.

  4. List of publications, if applicable, including copies of publications the applicant wishes the committee to assess.

  5. Verified copies of official bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and academic transcripts, provided in Danish or accompanied by an official English translation. Applicants currently enrolled in a master’s programme must include a statement indicating their expected completion date.

  6. Completed TEK PhD form for calculating grade point average.

  7. Official documentation describing the educational structure and grading system of the awarding institution, if the degree was obtained outside Denmark.

  8. Portfolio of up to 15 pages presenting selected research, teaching, or professional projects.

  9. Contact details for at least two referees, including their names and email addresses. The referees may be contacted during the selection process.

 The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

Assessment and Selection process
Read about the Assessment and selection process. An expert will assess applications. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation process.

 

Enrollment and Employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.
